question: Who among the following is considered as the founder of Islam?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prophet Muhammad**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prophet Muhammad** is considered the founder of Islam.
 
• He is believed to be the last prophet sent by God to guide humanity.
 
• Prophet Muhammad's teachings are compiled in the holy book of Islam, the **Quran**.
 
• He was born in Mecca in 570 CE and began receiving revelations from God at the age of 40.
 
• His teachings emphasized monotheism, social justice, and moral conduct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Islam is one of the world's major religions, with over a billion followers globally.
 
• The word "Islam" means "submission to the will of God."
 
• Muslims follow the Five Pillars of Islam, which are the basic acts of worship and the foundation of a Muslim's faith and practice.
 
• The life and teachings of Prophet Muhammad have had a profound impact on the world and continue to influence the lives of many people today.
 
• His migration from Mecca to Medina in 622 CE, known as the Hijra, marks the beginning of the Islamic calendar.
